slaved.source: build.json law: the built groove's blended law (verifier B1: C1 quadratic over blend 10 deg of q2), cut at the slot end dK_lim 46.5

free_play_deg.parts: slot slop crank held 0.04 + stage-1 crank-free 0.187 (dense scan)

slaved.note: K = law(q2): stage 1 (pin in the cap-ring groove: dwell holds K on stop A, the rise drives it) -> bell crank -> stage 2 (link 1a's nose in the crank's slot): form-closed both ways, no spring; the judge's equality is rigid - the 0.227 deg free play is not in the sim (stated)

j3_stop_built.rule: exported dowel (member 3) vs exported link 2 + J3 hub parts riding link 2, turned by q3' about J3 (signed mm, < 0 = metal in metal)

stop_engagement_built.rule: exported dowel turned about its joint's bearing axis vs the slotted part; engagement = first contact past the window (bisection, 0.0002 deg); target: K / J2 0.02 mm past (0.15 deg at r 7.75), J3 0 (exactly at J3MIN / J3MAX)

law_closure.rule: pin point (built level) in link 2's posed frame vs the built groove centreline; nose (C0) in the crank's posed frame vs the slot path at |dK|

kinematics_exact.note: summary recomputed from build.json check (the builder's in-run summary hit a NameError, fixed in user_style_desmo.py); stage 1 at the model's level (mode model): no relief, hub 2's samples all read; ring2 / crank / horn are the drive's model samples
